starter_files.contents:
# Dataset Explorer

Explore and visualize a synthetic or appropriately licensed dataset.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Column summaries and data types
- [ ] Missing-value and duplicate checks
- [ ] Descriptive statistics, charts, and a findings report

Use synthetic or properly licensed data. Do not commit credentials or personal data. Document setup, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.

"""Starter scaffold for Dataset Explorer.

Implement one milestone at a time and keep evaluation separate from development.
"""

def main():
    print("Project: Dataset Explorer")
    print("Next step: define inputs, outputs, baseline, and evaluation criteria.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

required_features: Descriptive statistics, charts, and a findings report
stretch_features: Add a repeatable evaluation script and a small regression-test suite.
Record data/model/configuration versions and document the deployment boundary.
Add accessible empty/error states and a clear route for human review where needed.

tests.name: Functional behavior
criteria: Required features work on realistic synthetic inputs.
Expected results and errors are documented.

tests.name: Evaluation and reproducibility
criteria: A baseline and an appropriate test strategy are included.
Dataset/model/configuration versions and key metrics are recorded.

tests.name: Safety, privacy, and operations
criteria: No secrets or unnecessary personal data are included.
Failures, limitations, and response/rollback paths are documented.
